title: Tour: Facebook Ads report
blurb: See your Facebook and Instagram ad spend next to the leads it brings.

steps.title: Open Facebook Ads
steps.body: Click **Facebook Ads**. Your Facebook and Instagram ad results show here. On some screens this tab is called **Meta Ads**.

steps.title: Nothing showing?
steps.body: Your Facebook ad account needs to be connected first. See **Connect Facebook Ads for reporting** in the Guide.

steps.title: Date range
steps.body: Set the date range at the top to match the period you want to check.

steps.title: Headline numbers
steps.body: The top cards show spend, reach, clicks and leads. Campaign, ad set and ad results sit below.

steps.title: What's next
steps.body: Next: try **Read your Facebook Ads report** from the Guide.
